title: DDN sparse authored file contract
description: Frozen planning contract. Default annotations do not mutate values; cross-record rules are normative in CONTRACT.md.

x.description: Offset shadow default 6; other silhouette default 0, in logical pixels.

y.description: Offset shadow default 8; other silhouette default 0, in logical pixels.

shadow.description: Optional bounded surface shadow. The containing shadow property defaults to null. On a supplied object, omitted values use the silhouette defaults. Does not alter semantic geometry or hit areas.

percentage.description: Authored allocation before progressive cap and remainder rules.
percentage.x-ddn-default-rule: automatic share of the remaining percentage; equal widths if all omitted

refresh.x-ddn-default-rule: supplied for host; manual for file/calculation; declaration never executes the producer
supplied for host; manual for file/calculation; declaration never executes the producer

visible.description: Show the main relationship caption. Omission follows the profile convention; internal mind-map branches always suppress it.

mode.description: Main relationship caption representation. Omission inherits view legend policy. Does not replace endpoint multiplicities or other method notation.

include.description: Membership in the relationship key, independent from inline caption visibility. Omission follows the existing view/profile legend policy.

authority.description: Host-validated capabilities; source/CSS cannot grant editing or remote delivery.

status_icon.description: Derived icon key, not an authored property; artwork belongs to the implementation asset design.

color.description: Kind default: push-pin #df4545; round-pin #45a3da; paper-clip #5b83b4; binder-clip #3b414b; tape #e4c788.

decoration.description: Decorative attachment only. Source order controls paint order. It confers no relation, vote, review status or authority.
